name: Nature's Sunshine Products
verdict: DEPLOY-as-staged (STARTER, small) — INDEPENDENT COURT ADJUDICATED. The principal's decisive challenge ('do I want to hold an MLM here?') is the RIGHT question and it is answered by EVIDENCE: the regulatory step-function tail is BOUNDED on both axes. (1) US/FTC: NATR sits firmly in the SURVIVOR cluster (Herbalife equity ROSE 8-18% on its FTC settlement; Neora WON at trial 2023, FTC declined appeal) not the shutdown cluster (Vemma/AdvoCare, which were RECRUITMENT-driven). The FTC's own dividing line — compensation 'based primarily on recruitment... and not on bona fide sales of products to consumers' — is quoted verbatim in NATR's own 10-K risk factor; a 50-yr manufacturer of real supplements with retail sales is a Herbalife/Neora, not an AdvoCare. (2) CHINA (the sharper tail, 46% of rev): STRUCTURALLY INSULATED by design of the license — VERBATIM 10-K: 'As an exception, in China we do NOT pay volume incentives; rather, we pay independent service fees.' China's licensed regime PROHIBITS multi-level comp, so the pyramid/传销 crackdown that killed grey-market operators is inapplicable to NATR's service-fee book by construction. NATR is 1 of only ~88 MOFCOM-licensed direct-sellers (since May-2017), alongside Amway/Herbalife/Nu-Skin/USANA. The tail is a FINE/business-drag risk (Nu-Skin took fines + a customer decline and survived; Amway thrives at $7.4B), NOT a binary shutdown. RP_FAIR PASSES: tail bounded + unlevered ($0 yr-end debt) + sleeve-capped (~0.7%). Own it small.

All 4 segments grew in local ccy: Asia $221.8M/46.2% (+6.7%), Europe $93.1M/19.4% (+9.8%), N.America $143.6M/29.9% (+3.4%), LatAm/Other $21.6M/4.5% (-5.5%). primary_source_verification.fx_flatter_recomputed: VERIFIED and QUANTIFIED. FX went -$1.7M loss (2024) -> +$5.1M income (2025) = a $6.8M pretax swing BELOW the operating line. Of the $12.6M net-income increase ($20.5M vs $7.9M), the FX swing is $6.8M = 54% of the NI jump is non-operating FX (matches ledger's '~53%'). NORMALIZED P/E: reported EPS $1.06 -> headline P/E 19.3x at live $20.43; stripping the after-tax FX gain (~$3.8-5.1M) gives normalized EPS ~$0.80-0.86 -> normalized P/E ~24-26x. So it is FAIRLY-to-slightly-RICHLY valued on earnings, NOT cheap. IMPORTANT: operating income $24.7M vs $20.1M (+23%) is NOT FX-boosted (FX is below the op line) -> EV/EBIT 11.0x, EV/Adj-EBITDA 5.5x at live px = reasonable-to-cheap on OPERATING metrics. The cheapness lives in the operating line; the P/E is flattered.
primary_source_verification.net_cash_and_geography: VERIFIED with a sharper caveat than the ledger. Cash $93.9M FY25 (-> $87.6M Q1'26); $0 interest-bearing debt at year-end; no prefs/converts. Q1'26 cash flow shows an $11.6M revolver draw+repay -> corroborates thin DOMESTIC liquidity despite $88M consolidated. BUT NOT 'trapped': 10-K asserts it does NOT intend to reinvest foreign earnings indefinitely (repatriation tax accrued, not a hidden surprise); residual friction = PRC/foreign FX controls + repatriation restrictions (disclosed).

decisive_question_adjudication.principal_challenge: Do I really want to hold an MLM here? (business-model regulatory TAIL question)
decisive_question_adjudication.finding: The worry is the RIGHT question but OVERSTATED by the evidence. The tail is BOUNDED, not binary, on both the US and China axes.
decisive_question_adjudication.us_ftc_tail: BOUNDED. Precedent distribution is bimodal and NATR is firmly in the SURVIVOR mode: Herbalife (real products, decades old) settled $200M + restructured and the EQUITY ROSE 8-18% intraday (enforcement RESOLVED the overhang); Neora (real supplements) WON at trial Sep-2023, FTC declined to appeal — first direct-seller to beat FTC since Amway 1979. The SHUTDOWN mode was RECRUITMENT-driven: AdvoCare forced to END multi-level entirely ($150M), Vemma restructured to a shell. The dividing line is retail-vs-recruitment + product legitimacy, which NATR's own 10-K quotes as the FTC's test. A 50-yr manufacturer selling real supplements to end consumers is structurally a survivor. Even in the ADVERSE case, the modal outcome is a fine + comp-plan tweak (bounded $), historically a stock POSITIVE once resolved.
decisive_question_adjudication.china_tail: BOUNDED (sharper than US but still not binary). NATR holds a scarce MOFCOM direct-selling license (1 of ~88; since May-2017). China law ALREADY bans multi-level comp, so NATR's China model is a license-mandated single-level SERVICE-FEE structure (verbatim above) — the pyramid-crackdown axis is inapplicable by design. Comparable-tail evidence: Nu-Skin took China fines (2014) + a customer decline (150k->118k) and SURVIVED with license intact; Amway thrives at $7.4B despite past 'crackdown' headlines. The 2024-25 regulatory trajectory is CONSTRUCTIVE (State Council revising the 2005 regs; industry reads positive). The only genuine UNBOUNDED sub-tail is a wholesale PRC license revocation / expropriation — a low-probability political step-function that would impair ~46% of revenue; it is real, unhedgeable, and the reason this is a STARTER not a full position, but it is NOT the base case and does not fail RP_FAIR at 0.7% size.
decisive_question_adjudication.rp_fair_gate: PASSES. Doctrine: fairly-paid risk is ownable IF tails are bounded/unlevered/sleeve-capped. (a) Bounded: yes — both axes are fine/business-drag, not binary, per the evidence above; the residual PRC-expropriation tail is low-p and is the sizing constraint, not a disqualifier. (b) Unlevered: yes — $0 year-end debt, net cash $88M, no margin used on the position. (c) Sleeve-capped: yes — ~0.7% of the $1M base, well within a starter envelope. Verdict: RP_FAIR-DILIGENCE, ownable in starter size.
decisive_question_adjudication.reputational_overlay: MINOR, does not change the verdict. 'Long an MLM' carries a brand cost for a radically-honest fund, but (i) the honest, defensible framing IS the product — the thesis is 'we verified the melting-MLM trap is false and the regulatory tail is bounded via the service-fee structure,' which is a differentiated, primary-sourced call, not a promotional long; (ii) at a $7k starter the reputational exposure is de minimis; (iii) NATR is a licensed real-product manufacturer, not a recruitment scheme — the reputational risk is being WRONG on the tail, which the evidence bounds. Note it, don't overweight it.

edge_explainer.market_believes: A no-growth legacy MLM — a melting annuity worth a low multiple; cheap because the distributor base is aging/eroding; and an MLM carries an unquantified regulatory blow-up tail.
edge_explainer.we_believe: It's not melting (revenue ATH, all segments grew local-ccy, VI payout flat/falling, disciplined buyback, net cash), and the regulatory tail is BOUNDED: NATR is a Herbalife/Neora-type survivor on the US axis and its China book is a license-mandated single-level SERVICE-FEE model that structurally sidesteps the pyramid-crackdown axis. The genuine catch is the HEADLINE P/E is FX-flattered (fairly ~24x normalized, not cheap) and there is a low-probability PRC-expropriation tail on 46% of revenue that caps the size at starter.
edge_explainer.why_we_might_have_edge: The honesty contribution is (a) catching the FX-flattering of the marketed 'cheap 18x' (normalized ~24x), (b) confirming the base is NOT melting via VI/GM/segment proxies, and (c) BOUNDING the regulatory tail with the FTC precedent distribution + the verbatim China service-fee structure — de-risking a name a naive melting-MLM/pyramid-tail short would fade.
edge_explainer.why_it_might_be_priced_in: At ~24x normalized earnings on ~4-5% organic growth it is fairly valued; the edge is only the buyback accretion + normalization optionality, both modest.
edge_explainer.what_resolves_it: Two more quarters of ex-FX growth >=5% (confirming the base is healthy) and an uninterrupted China service-fee model. Either the cadence holds (add) or it fades (stand down).
edge_explainer.mechanism_falsifier: The volume-incentive/sales ratio turning up = direct evidence the base IS melting; a PRC enforcement action against NATR specifically = the China tail firing. Either re-opens the trap thesis.
edge_explainer.edge_type: VALUE / RP_FAIR-DILIGENCE — fairly-valued quality direct-seller with a buyback-accretion + normalization-optionality overlay and a BOUNDED (not binary) regulatory tail; own the factor in small starter size, not a table-pounder
